name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a passion for racing itself, but through a fascination with the intricate teamwork required behind the scenes. After completing his degree in Human Resource Management, he initially worked in the oil and gas sector in Aberdeen, Scotland. However, the allure of motorsport, particularly the fast-paced environment and the need for high-performing teams, drew him in. He joined Brad Jones Racing three years ago, bringing a fresh perspective on talent acquisition and employee development.

Alistair is a firm believer in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the team. He focuses on identifying and nurturing talent, ensuring that every team member has the resources and support they need to excel. His detail-oriented approach extends to all aspects of HR, from recruitment and training to performance management and employee well-being. He prides himself on creating a supportive and inclusive work environment where individuals can thrive.

What sets Alistair apart is his strategic vision for building a sustainable and high-performing team. He's not just filling vacancies; he's carefully crafting a team dynamic that will propel Brad Jones Racing to success. He is always looking for innovative ways to improve the employee experience, and he is a strong advocate for diversity and inclusion.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a lean build and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas during meetings.
Insists on having a pot of Scottish Breakfast tea brewing in his office at all times.
Uses motorsport analogies excessively when explaining HR policies.
